title: The ZTC Terraform provider: where its behavior is described

prose.text: This walks the subjects that describe what the ZTC provider (Zscaler's name for the Cloud and Branch Connector provider, built on the Go SDK) sends, reads and reports. Which API paths and SDK packages each resource uses, and its arguments, validators and nested blocks, are generated from the provider code: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <resource name>`; `provider:ztw` gives the provider's own settings.

prose.label: Configuring the provider.
prose.text: Credentials, environment variables, defaults and government clouds are in [[cloud-connector.terraform.provider-config]]; client construction, ignored settings and text normalization in [[cloud-connector.terraform.provider-behavior]]; secrets in [[shared.terraform.credential-handling]].

prose.label: Activating.
prose.text: The activation resource and the ztcActivator CLI are in [[cloud-connector.terraform.activation]].

prose.label: Rules.
prose.text: Forward methods, ZPA segment IDs, workload groups and DNS rule constraints are in [[cloud-connector.terraform.forwarding-rules]]; rule order in [[cloud-connector.terraform.rule-order]]; predefined rules in [[cloud-connector.terraform.rule-protection]]; reference cleanup on delete in [[cloud-connector.terraform.delete-detach]].

prose.label: Gateways.
prose.text: Forwarding and DNS gateways are in [[cloud-connector.terraform.gateways]].

prose.label: Coverage and documentation.
prose.text: What has no resource and how to import is in [[cloud-connector.terraform.coverage]]; documentation errors and the location template checks in [[cloud-connector.terraform.doc-errata]].

prose.label: Through the SDK.
prose.text: Paging limits that drop records from state are in [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination]], zero values that cannot be sent in [[shared.sdk-go.zero-value-writes]], and ZTW service defects in [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.service-defects]].
